instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: This car park has no more vacancy, so we need to find another.
atoms.b: This car park has no more ((vacancy)), so we need to find another.

atoms.a: There is a slight discrepancy between the two scientific studies.
atoms.b: There is a slight ((discrepancy)) between the two scientific studies.

atoms.a: Hiking up the mountain was a big endeavour, but the view at the top made it all worthwhile.
atoms.b: Hiking up the mountain was a big ((endeavour)), but the view at the top made it all worthwhile.

atoms.a: Leon and Dave need to watch the film and provide critique in an essay for their film class.
atoms.b: Leon and Dave need to watch the film and provide ((critique)) in an essay for their film class.

atoms.a: The ingenious idea was a result of their dedication and strong teamwork.
atoms.b: The ((ingenious)) idea was a result of their dedication and strong teamwork.

atoms.a: Jacob has respiratory allergies and sneezes a lot whenever he goes into the garden.
atoms.b: Jacob has ((respiratory)) allergies and sneezes a lot whenever he goes into the garden.
